Mr. Sieber had sexual intercourse with M.M. while she was unconscious
Her next memory is of waking up naked on the couch the following morning.

his mother's forced attendance at residential schools and associated loss of parenting skills and familial composition
The most significant mitigating aspect in the present case are Mr. Sieber's Gladue factors
I also take judicial notice of the impact that the history of colonialism, displacement, and residential schools has had on Indigenous persons

crime_highlights: Mr. Mcintosh was seen driving a motor vehicle which he was prohibited from doing
A search revealed two bundles of cash, 6.9 grams of fentanyl, and 5.22 grams of methamphetamine
The victims in cases that involve drug trafficking are, of course, the community at large.
There continues to be roughly seven deaths per day in this province with regard to unregulated drugs.
rationale_highlights: the presentence report details a dysfunctional, chaotic, and unstable upbringing
many of the circumstances, regardless of background, that are experienced by Indigenous people in Canada are present in Mr. Mcintosh's life including homelessness and poverty
the fact that Mr. Mcintosh has had, by all accounts, a very unfortunate upbringing that leads him to the place that he is today
note: Court treats unfortunate upbringing as mitigating; joint submission accepted.

crime_highlights: Mr. Hutchison put Mr. Hill in a headlock with his right arm around the back of Mr. Hill's neck
Mr. Hutchison punched Mr. Hill in the nose three to four times in groups of three punches
Mr. Hutchison did not release the headlock.
When police arrived Mr. Hill was unconscious.
Mr. Hill was taken to hospital where he was put on life support. He died a couple of days later, minutes after being removed from life support.
rationale_highlights: Mr. Hutchison has certainly been impacted by intergenerational trauma
He overcame a difficult childhood to become a well-respected member of his community
Having regard to all of the circumstances and Mr. Hutchison's background, I find that his moral blameworthiness is on the lower end of the scale.
note: Intergenerational trauma is brief; lower blameworthiness rests on all circumstances combined.
